name: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
drops: Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen

name: Dragonkin Soldier
about: A Dragonkin Soldier encountered in the lower part of Ainsel River, in a cave with a giant chair-crypt. Once it's health is below 60%, it sprouts wings and begins using frozen lightning-based attacks, such as lightning spears and AoEs.

name: Crystalian (Spear) & Crystalian (Ringblade)
about: * Crystalian (Spear): 1,892 HP * Crystalian (Ringblade): 1,892 HP A pair of Crystalians are a boss located at the end of Altus Tunnel. They drop 9,000 runes and the [[Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 2| Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] ]] There are no objects in the arena to hide behind and it's quite small, so if no Spirit Ash is used you will be under near-constant assault by the duo, as the spear-wielder pursues and the ringblade-wielder attacks from afar.

name: Divine Bridge Golem
grace: Divine Tower of West Altus Gate

name: Ancient Hero of Zamor
about: A Zamor knight encountered at the end of the Sainted Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau.

name: Black Knife Assassin
about: This assassin is invisible, save for the ripples she makes in the water in her boss room. Using the Sentry's Torch will render her visible.

name: Black Knife Assassin
about: A Black Knife Assassin blocks the entrance to the Sainted Hero's Grave, located in central Altus Plateau.

name: Erdtree Burial Watchdog
about: A sword-wielding Erdtree Burial Watchdog with a tail that crackles with electricity, maintaining the lightning theme present in the rest of the dungeon. It can emit lightning from its mouth.

name: Fallingstar Beast
about: A Fallingstar Beast found in a crater in Altus Plateau, south of the steps leading to Capital Outskirts, and south-east of the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace. The route leading to it is pockmarked with smaller craters, and there are several Starcallers and Leyndell Soldiers nearby.

name: Godskin Apostle
about: A Godskin Apostle at the highest point of Dominula, Windmill Village oversees the Dominula Dancer's Dominula Festival. Torrent may be used during this fight. Millicent is available as a summon for this fight, provided she has been given the Valkyrie's Prosthesis.

name: Night's Cavalry
about: A flail-wielding Night's Cavalry encountered on the road southwest of the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace in the Altus Plateau.

name: Omenkiller
about: An Omenkiller fought alongside Miranda the Blighted Bloom at the end of the Perfumer's Grotto on the Altus Plateau.

name: Tibia Mariner
about: A Tibia Mariner encountered in Wyndham Ruins in Altus Plateau. It is surrounded by many skeletons, and can summon giant skeletons during combat. The giant skeletons are able to fire death beams from their eye sockets.

name: Tree Sentinel
about: A duo of Tree Sentinels fought at the top of the steps leading up to the gate to the Capital Outskirts, just before the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace. One wields a shield while the other carries a torch. Although they have separate health bars, both must be defeated to clear the boss and obtain the rewards.

name: Starscourge Radahn
drops: Remembrance of the Starscourge, Radahn's Great Rune

name: Death Rite Bird
about: Found at night. Go east and slightly south of the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank grace.

name: Frenzied Duelist
about: An axe-wielding Frenzied Duelist is encountered at the end of the Gaol Cave in Caelid.

name: Putrid Crystalian (Ringblade) & Putrid Crystalian (Spear) & Putrid Crystalian (Staff)
about: * Putrid Crystalian (Staff): 3,358 HP * Putrid Crystalian (Ringblade): 3,358 HP * Putrid Crystalian (Spear): 3,358 HP A trio of Putrid Crystalians guard their crystals at the end of Sellia Hideaway. They drop 7,100 runes and the Crystal Torrent sorcery.

name: Cemetery Shade
about: A Cemetery Shade that is found in the sealed chamber at the end of Caelid Catacombs.

name: Magma Wyrm
about: A Magma Wyrm is encountered at the end of Gael Tunnel in Caelid.

name: Erdtree Burial Watchdog
about: A pair of three-headed Erdtree Burial Watchdogs, one with a sword and the other a scepter.

name: Fallingstar Beast
about: A Fallingstar Beast found in a cave at the end of Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid.

name: Mad Pumpkin Head
about: A pair of Mad Pumpkin Heads, one with a hammer and the other a flail. Both of their weapons have been lit on fire. The left Pumpkin Head will be sitting with its back as you enter, so make sure to attack it quickly to try and reduce this 1v2 to a 1v1. It's possible to use Torrent in this fight, though it's unlikely to be useful due to how small the room is.

name: Night's Cavalry
drops: Ash of War: Poison Moth Flight
about: A flail-wielding Night's Cavalry who patrols the roads south of the Swamp of Aeonia, close to where the Map: Caelid map fragment is obtained.

name: Grave Warden Duelist
about: A Duelist with dual Battle Hammers encountered at the end of the Auriza Side Tomb, alongside a number of Little Living Jars.

name: Deathbird
about: A Deathbird is encountered on a cliff overlooking a Minor Erdtree in the northern Capital Outskirts, northeast of the Hermit Merchant's Shack. It spawns at night, near a moangrave surrounded by Giant Death Snails.

name: Onyx Lord
about: An Onyx Lord encountered at the end of the Sealed Tunnel in Altus Plateau, obstructing the exit that leads to the Divine Tower of West Altus.

name: Death Rite Bird
about: Found at night, Southeast of the Apostate Derelict grace and at the end of the frozen river.

name: Putrid Grave Warden Duelist
about: A rotten Duelist wielding a Greataxe encountered at the end of the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.

name: Night's Cavalry
about: A pair of Night's Cavalry, one with a flail and the other with a glaive. Both must be defeated to clear the boss. Encountered escorting a Great Coffin carriage bearing the Flowing Curved Sword through the southern part of the Consecrated Snowfield. After spawning at the Inner Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace and turning 90 degrees to the left one will see the Caravan slowly appearing.

name: Godskin Duo
drops: Ash of War: Black Flame Tornado

name: Fia's Champion & Sorcerer Rogier & Lionel the Lionhearted
Black Blade Kindred
about: A Black Blade Kindred who appears in the Forbidden Lands as the player approaches the Grand Lift of Rold on the way to the Mountaintops of the Giants. It wields a twinblade and an axe. Millicent is available as a summon for this fight, provided she has been given the Valkyrie's Prosthesis and has been spoken to in Dominula, Windmill Village. {| class="article-table" ! colspan="3" |Move Name |- |Phase |Damage Type |Can Be Parried/Cannot Be Parried |- | colspan="3" |Description of move |- ! colspan="3" |Move Name |- |Phase |Damage Type |Can Be Parried/Cannot Be Parried |- | colspan="3" |Descript

name: Night's Cavalry
about: A glaive-wielding Night's Cavalry fought in the narrow passage beyond the Forbidden Lands Site of Grace.

name: Beastman of Farum Azula
about: Two Beastmen are encountered in Dragonbarrow Cave in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. One fights from range, using paired throwing knives, while the other uses a large cleaver.

name: Black Blade Kindred
about: A Black Blade Kindred who stands guard outside the Bestial Sanctum in Caelid. It wields a halberd and a greatsword. It is possible to avoid this boss by using the sending gate north of the Third Church of Marika, which will teleport the player to the door to the Bestial Sanctum, behind the boss. {| class="article-table" ! colspan="3" |Move Name |- |Phase |Damage Type |Can Be Parried/Cannot Be Parried |- | colspan="3" |Description of move |- ! colspan="3" |Move Name |- |Phase |Damage Type |Can Be Parried/Cannot Be Parried |- | colspan="3" |Description of move |- ! colspan="3" |Move Name |- |Pha

name: Cleanrot Knight
about: A Cleanrot Knight and its commander, both encountered in an alcove at the very end of Abandoned Cave that has been partially flooded by scarlet rot. The remains of numerous Abudctor Virgins lay scattered around the arena. As the fight starts, only the spear-wielder is present, with the scythe-wielding commander rising from the rot pool to the left within 12 seconds of starting the battle. As such, it is best to spend that opening either summoning a Spirit or rushing down the spear knight to try and at least severely wound it before the scythe knight can join the fray. Of the two combatants, th

name: Godskin Apostle
about: A Godskin Apostle is found at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid, guarding a chest containing the Godslayer's Greatsword. To reach this boss, the player must complete a platforming section through the inside of the tower, which includes encounters with Redmane Knights and Blackflame Monks.

name: Night's Cavalry
about: A glaive-wielding Night's Cavalry found on a bridge in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow, north of Lenne's Rise.

name: Radagon of the Golden Order / Elden Beast
Godfrey, First Elden Lord (golden shade)
about: Nepheli Loux, Warrior and Shabriri are both available as summons for this fight, provided their questlines have been completed. Like the first battle, this fight is not optional and must be defeated to reach the final bosses of the game. {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed article-table centerheaders " | colspan="2" style="text-align:center; background-color: black; color: white;" |Moveset List   |- !Ground Smash !Phase 1 |- | colspan="2" |Slams his axe into the ground, leaving half of it buried for a moment, before pulling it back out, causing a small earthquake. |- !Axe Swings !Phase

drops: the Fell Omen not already defeated)

name: Grave Warden Duelist
about: A Duelist with dual Battle Hammers encountered at the end of Murkwater Catacombs.

name: Beastman of Farum Azula
about: An armored, cleaver-wielding Beastman found in the Groveside Cave in Limgrave. It is encountered in a wide cavern littered with dead Godrick Soldiers, who appear to have set up a camp before falling victim to the Beastman.

name: Black Knife Assassin
about: This assassin sustained a grievous wound, retreating deep within the Deathtouched Catacombs. Uniquely, her health bar has already been partially depleted before the player arrives so that she starts at 60% HP. She is the only wounded Black Knife Assassin. Although red blood stains her armor, she bleeds darkness on hit. She drops the Assassin's Crimson Dagger, a Talisman which allows the player to recover HP after performing a critical hit.

name: Deathbird
about: Found east of the Warmaster's Shack at night. From the shack's site of grace, walk east and get on top of the first fallen ruins seen. Trolls, Man-Bats, and Rams surround the area.

name: Erdtree Burial Watchdog
about: A sword-wielding Erdtree Burial Watchdog encountered in Stormfoot Catacombs. It's tail ignites during combat, allowing it to deal fire damage when performing a tail slam.

name: Mad Pumpkin Head
about: A flail-wielding Pumpkin Head found in a cellar beneath Waypoint Ruins in Limgrave. The warrior obstructs the entrance to a second chamber, where Sorceress Sellen resides. The room isn't very big but the boss also isn't that quick or good at turning. If you are about to be boxed into a corner, try to run around it to recover or to hit it from behind so that the head's heavy damage reduction isn't applied. Astrologers will most likely want to be extra careful since their FP and its recovery will most likely be very low by this point, as will the variety in Sorceries.

name: Night's Cavalry
about: A glaive-wielding Night's Cavalry found patrolling the bridge to the southeast of the Agheel Lake North Site of Grace in Limgrave. There are several Godrick Soldiers and Godrick Foot Soldiers on the west side of the bridge who should be defeated before attempting to challenge the boss.

name: Tibia Mariner
about: A Tibia Mariner encountered in Summonwater Village in north-eastern Limgrave. D, Hunter of the Dead, can be found nearby to offer a warning about the mariner in the village, and is also available as a summonable co-operator for the fight. The mariner will summon skeletons regularly throughout the fight.

name: Ulcerated Tree Spirit
about: An Ulcerated Tree Spirit encountered at the end of the Fringefolk Hero's Grave. This tree spirit will drop a Golden Seed and the ashes of Banished Knight Oleg upon its defeat.

name: Crystalian (Ringblade)
about: * Crystalian (Spear): 1,595 A ringblade-wielding Crystalian boss is located at the very bottom of the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel. It drops 3,000 runes and the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing. Since this Crystalian is encountered on its own, jumping heavy attacks may safely break its Stance. Remain wary of the Crystalian's ranged attacks as they can hit at inopportune times.

name: Crystalian (Staff) & Crystalian (Spear)
about: * Crystalian (Spear): 1,595 HP * Crystalian (Staff): 1,595 HP A Crystalian boss duo is located in a wide chamber at the end of the Academy Crystal Cave. They drop 3,300 runes and the Crystal Release sorcery. Generally only one is aggressive at a time. Since the spear-wielder pursues the player more actively, it's generally best to try and take care of it first. The pillars in the room can be used to hide from the staff-wielder's sorceries.

name: Crystalians
location: Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel, Academy Crystal Cave, Altus Tunnel

name: Spiritcaller Snail
grace: Village of the Albinaurics (Site of Grace)
drops: Ash of War: Black Flame Tornado

name: Onyx Lord
about: An Onyx Lord imprisoned within the Royal Grave Evergaol, besides the graveyard behind Caria Manor.

name: Cemetery Shade
about: A Cemetery Shade is found in the sealed chamber at the end of the Black Knife Catacombs. Several skeletons spawn during this fight, making it more challenging to focus on the boss.

name: Black Knife Assassin
about: The ringleader of the Black Knife Assassins is currently imprisoned in an Evergaol in the Moonlight Altar area of Liurnia of the Lakes. Tiche, Alecto's daughter, died protecting her mother during their flight from the Capital after the assassination of Godwyn.

name: Cleanrot Knight
about: A lone Cleanrot Knight, encountered in an alcove at the very end of Stillwater Cave that has been partially flooded in poisonous waters. Most of the room is full of poisonous water, so it's advisable to quickly run to the small island of safety just left of the boss, in the middle left to far left section of the room. Since this boss is the spear-wielding variant and this fight will most likely happen early in the game, it's critical to avoid its Scarlet Rot-inducing, charging grab attack (signified by its spear glowing a bright gold). This is most easily accomplished by rolling diagonally for

name: Deathbird
about: Found at night and spawns when near the fallen ruins that are very close and northeast of the Scenic Isle grace.

name: Erdtree Avatar
about: An Erdtree Avatar that guards the Minor Erdtree on the eastern side of Liurnia. It is encountered near a congregation of Ancestral Followers.

name: Erdtree Avatar
about: An Erdtree Avatar that guards the Minor Erdtree on the western side of Liurnia.

name: Night's Cavalry
about: A glaive-wielding Night's Cavalry fought on a ruin-strewn road on the Bellum Highway, found northeast of the East Raya Lucaria Gate Site of Grace.

name: Night's Cavalry
about: A glaive-wielding Night's Cavalry fought down the road southeast of the Gate Town Bridge Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.

name: Omenkiller
about: An Omenkiller found in the Village of the Albinaurics in Liurnia of the Lakes, across the bridge from the Site of Grace. This Omenkiller appears to be responsible for the slaughter of the Albinaurics on the orders of Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. This Omenkiller is accompanied by three dogs. Nepheli Loux, Warrior is available as a summon for this boss, provided she was spoken to at the entrance to the Village of the Albinaurics. A magic user with a guided bolt-like spell such as Glintstone Pebble has a particularly efficient tactical option for this Omenkiller: the area he is in also cont

name: Tibia Mariner
about: A Tibia Mariner encountered on the eastern plateau of Liurnia of the Lakes, in a graveyard near the Carian Study Hall and south-east of the Artist's Shack (Liurnia). This Mariner can summon Skeletal Militiamen.

name: Glintstone Dragon Adula
drops: Cathedral of Manus Celes: Adula's Moonblade

name: Death Rite Bird
about: Found at day or night, far west of the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook grace, past the cemetery and facing the cliff. There is a Stake of Marika nearby.

name: Ancient Hero of Zamor
about: A Zamor knight encountered at the end of the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

name: Erdtree Avatar
about: An Erdtree Avatar that guards the Minor Erdtree in the Mountaintops of the Giants. This Avatar has the unique ability to split itself into two different Avatars once it's health is below 70%, with both enemies sharing a health bar.

name: Godskin Apostle
about: The spirit of a Godskin Apostle, along with that of a Godskin Noble, is summoned by the Spiritcaller Snail at the end of Spiritcaller Cave in the Mountaintops of the Giants. The Apostle must be defeated first, followed by the Noble, before the snail appears and can be killed to end the fight.

name: Ulcerated Tree Spirit
about: A tree spirit fought at the end of the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs. It drops a Golden Seed and the [[Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing 2| Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2] ]] upon its defeat.

name: God Devouring Serpent/ Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
Magma Wyrm
about: A Magma Wyrm is encountered in a lava pool near Fort Laiedd, southwest of the Seethewater Terminus Site of Grace. It can be lured out of the lava for an easier fight. After defeating this boss, Magma Breath can be obtained at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 1 Dragon Heart.

name: Ulcerated Tree Spirit
about: A tree spirit encountered at the Minor Erdtree (Mt. Gelmir), lingering in the aftermath of the Assault on Volcano Manor. It drops the Leaden Hardtear and Cerulean Hidden Tear upon its defeat.

name: Dragonkin Soldier
about: A Dragonkin Soldier encountered in Siofra River, found by dropping down several ledges south of the Worshipper's Woods Site of Grace.

name: Godrick the Grafted
drops: Godrick's Great Rune, Remembrance of the Grafted

name: Ancient Hero of Zamor
about: A Zamor knight was graced by Lord Radagon. They were sealed within an evergaol between the Fourth Church of Marika and the Church of Pilgrimage for unknown reasons. It carries Radagon's Scarseal and is found in the Weeping Evergaol, which must be unlocked with a Stonesword Key.

name: Cemetery Shade
about: A Cemetery Shade is found in the sealed chamber at the end of Tombsward Catacombs.

name: Deathbird
about: * Defense: 105 Found at night, northwest of Castle Morne, on top of the cliff. Walk near the Fallen Ruins to make it appear. There are Tarnished Golden Sunflowers where it spawns that can be used to make Holy Water Pots (recipe from Missionary's Cookbook 1, bought from Merchant Kalé).

name: Erdtree Avatar
about: An Erdtree Avatar that guards the Minor Erdtree in the Weeping Peninsula.

name: Erdtree Burial Watchdog
about: A three-headed Watchdog accompanied by four Imps. It can breathe fire from all three of its mouths.

name: Night's Cavalry
about: A flail-wielding Night's Cavalry found at night patrolling the road in the Weeping Peninsula, near the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace. Will next to the wall and can later be seen going down the road in front of the grace.

name: Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame
drops: Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame

name: Romina, Saint of the Bud
grace: Church of the Bud, Main Entrance
drops: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud

name: Death Rite Bird
about: Found at night, North of the Charo's Hidden Grave grace. Surrounded by Gravebirds that spit Ghostflame fireballs, so it is recommended to kill those first to avoid getting ganked in the middle of the fight.

name: Promised Consort Radahn / Radahn, Consort of Miquella
drops: Remembrance of a God and a Lord

name: Rellana, Twin Moon Knight
drops: Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight

name: Tree Sentinel
about: A Tree Sentinel patrols a segment of the road connecting the Church of Elleh to Fringefolk Hero's Grave, found past the First Step. Although it is typically the first boss players encounter beyond the Stranded Graveyard, it is too powerful for low-level characters. It can be circumvented by sneaking through the grass, avoiding the dirt path and the Knight's line of sight.

name: Death Rite Bird
about: Found at night. A short distance South of the Gate Town North grace, in the area in-between the small islands and ruins.

name: Metyr, Mother of Fingers
drops: Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers

name: Black Knight Edredd
drops: Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings

name: Commander Gaius
drops: Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider

name: Tree Sentinel
about: A duo of Tree Sentinels found in the Hinterlands of Scaduview, guarding the path to the Minor Erdtree incantation. The shield bearer starts out on to the left, on the path to riding across the nearby bridge, while the torch-wielder is riding down the path from Shaman Village. This means they are quite easy to fight separately. As with the Altus duo both of these must be defeated to get their runes, but their respective Blessings are dropped the first time each is killed. * Swordhand of Night Jolán can be summoned as a cooperator for this encounter.
